title: As Midterms Near, Top Law Firms That Capitulated to Trump Are on the Sidelines
summary: None of the firms that struck deals to avoid crippling executive orders are publicly involved in the major legal efforts to check the Trump administration’s attempts to meddle in the midterm elections, a review by The New York Times shows.
